title: lithocarpus hypophoeniceus
intro: Lithocarpus hypophoeniceus, commonly known as the red-barked oak, is a species of evergreen tree that belongs to the beech family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and it is used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus hypophoeniceus involve treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, as well as having a protective effect on the liver and kidneys. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
